_doc: Registered NON-book resource source prefixes. A syllabus.yaml resource string resolves if a bookmap.json key OR one of these prefixes matches the start of the string (the longest-prefix rule in resources/RESOURCES.md). Register a source here (or add the book to bookmap.json) BEFORE citing it in the syllabus: validate_syllabus.py fails the build on any unresolvable citation, which is the anti-hallucination catch. Keep this list flat and specific. A name matches only when the citation ends there or continues with a non-alphanumeric delimiter (space/punctuation), so 'Ripser' matches 'Ripser 1.2' but not 'Ripserext', and an empty entry matches nothing.
